candidates.description: This vector activates in contexts related to the COVID-19 pandemic, public health crises, and associated political figures.
This vector represents sequential integers within the range of 10 to 30.
This vector represents plural nouns denoting general entities, conditions, or categories in Spanish.
This feature vector represents the Latin root "act-"/"viv-" and its morphological variants associated with activity, life, and effectiveness across different languages.
These tokens represent adverbial and nominal suffixes, primarily in Romance languages like Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, and French, used to form adverbs of manner or abstract nouns.
This vector activates for Spanish adjectives and quantifiers denoting variety, difference, or importance.
This feature vector activates on verbs ending in a variation of the Latin root "-form" or "-pond" related to actions of state, communication, or change.
This vector activates on various two- and three-digit integers.
This feature vector represents common Spanish auxiliary and modal verbs expressing possibility, obligation, or state.
This vector is related to common word roots and prefixes beginning with the letters "se", "re", or "leg" across Spanish and English.
